content_preview:
name: Five-Level Verification (S4)

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'skills/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'skills/**'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      skill:
        description: '要验证的Skill名称'
        required: true
        type: string
      level:
        description: '验证级别'
        required: false
        default: 'L4'
        type: choice
        options:
          - L1
          - L2
          - L3
          - L4

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
